primary.name: portfolio-performance-attributor
primary.implementation_scope: Legacy single-period Brinson; explicit multiplicative currency, parallel duration/convexity, supplied factor and chronological linking methods, retained residuals and engine-result challenge

supporting.name: portfolio-performance-measurer
supporting.implementation_scope: Linked subperiod TWR, explicitly timed Modified Dietz and bounded conventional dated XIRR; no GIPS certification

supporting.name: portfolio-exposure-analyzer
supporting.implementation_scope: Supplied NAV and market-value exposures; bounded one-level look-through

supporting.name: portfolio-risk-contribution-analyzer
supporting.implementation_scope: Supplied covariance annualized-volatility Euler contribution only

supporting.name: investment-commentary-builder
supporting.implementation_scope: Supplied reconciled figures and approved-message commentary; no performance engine

plans.overlay_requirements: Benchmark, method, period, currency and gross/net basis; overlapping attribution methods are not additive
